claims: Joshua Tree National Park is in Southern California.
Joshua Tree National Park is a 790,000-acre protected area.
The Mojave and Colorado deserts meet at Joshua Tree National Park.
The Joshua tree is Yucca brevifolia.
Yucca brevifolia was named by 19th-century Mormon settlers.
19th-century Mormon settlers believed the branches of the Joshua tree resembled the biblical figure Joshua reaching up to the sky to guide them.
Joshua trees are not trees.
Joshua trees are the largest species of yucca.
Yucca is a type of succulent.
Hidden Valley is a loop trail surrounded by massive boulders.
Keys View offers panoramic views of the Coachella Valley, Salton Sea, and San Andreas Fault.
Skull Rock is a naturally eroded rock formation resembling a skull.
Arch Rock is a natural rock arch near the White Tank Campground.
Cholla Cactus Garden is a dense patch of Teddy Bear Cholla cactus.
Joshua Tree National Park is a Dark Sky Park.
Joshua Tree National Park features creosote scrub, ocotillo, and various cacti.
Scott's orioles and ladder-backed woodpeckers are common birds in Joshua Tree National Park.
Joshua trees rely exclusively on the yucca moth for pollination.
A fee is required for entry to Joshua Tree National Park.
Camping is allowed only in designated sites in Joshua Tree National Park.
Collecting wood for fires is illegal in Joshua Tree National Park.
Joshua Tree National Park was originally proposed as Desert Plants National Park.
Joshua Tree National Park was established as a National Monument in 1936.
Joshua Tree National Park was designated a National Park in 1994.
The Serrano, Cahuilla, and Chemehuevi have inhabited the land of Joshua Tree National Park for thousands of years.
Cattlemen and miners inhabited the land of Joshua Tree National Park after indigenous groups.
Summer temperatures in Joshua Tree National Park often exceed 100°F (38°C).
Cell service is very limited in Joshua Tree National Park.

The desert tortoise is protected.
